goals.title: Savings goals
goals.subtitle: Give your savings a purpose and see what to set aside each month.
goals.name: Goal name
goals.emptyBody: Plan an emergency fund, a holiday, or an annual bill.
goals.allocationNote: Recording a goal does not move money. Allocate each saved amount to one goal only; savings held in your cash balance are reserved from available spending.
goals.deadlineHelp: Leave blank for ongoing savings without a deadline.
goals.contributionSchedule: Contributions are reserved on the first of each month, starting next month, until the target or deadline is reached. Update “Already saved” as you make progress.
goals.noContributionDates: No scheduled contribution remains before this deadline. Add savings now or adjust the date.

locationDescription.included_cash: Already saved money is included in your bank cash balance and will be reserved from available spending.
locationDescription.external: Already saved money is held elsewhere and will not be deducted again. Future contributions still reduce available cash.

goals.validation: Enter a name, a positive target, non-negative savings and contributions, and a valid date if used. Amounts may not exceed ₪1 billion.
goals.requiredContribution: Needed to meet the date: {{amount}} per month
goals.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}” and release its cash reservation? This does not move money or change account balances.

scenarios.title: What if?
scenarios.subtitle: Explore a purchase, a change in rent, or a different income and keep plans to compare later.
scenarios.name: Scenario name
scenarios.emptyBody: See how a decision would change your cash before you make it.
scenarios.simulationNote: A scenario is a separate simulation. Saving it keeps these assumptions for later; your transactions, budgets, savings goals, and current forecast stay unchanged.
scenarios.signedHelp: Enter changes relative to your current forecast: negative amounts reduce cash; positive amounts add cash. For rent rising by ₪500, enter −500 monthly. For a one-time ₪2,000 bonus, enter +2000.
scenarios.dateHelp: Choose tomorrow or later; the projection starts tomorrow.
scenarios.monthlyHelp: Repeats on this day each month, or the last day in shorter months. An earlier anchor is allowed; only future occurrences count.
scenarios.endDateHelp: Include occurrences through this date, or leave blank to continue.
scenarios.validation: Name the scenario and each change. Enter a nonzero signed amount up to ₪1 billion and a valid date for every change. One-time dates must be tomorrow or later; monthly end dates must allow a future occurrence.
scenarios.horizonHelp: Only changes occurring in the next {{days}} days are included.
scenarios.previewPrompt: Compare to see the effect of your current entries. Editing an entry clears the previous comparison.
scenarios.previewError: The comparison could not be loaded. Please compare again.
scenarios.incomplete: Complete the available-to-spend setup above to compare cash balances. You can still save this scenario.
scenarios.availableHelp: Available spending reserves outflows through the detected next income date, or the next 30 days when no reliable payday is detected. Future income, including positive scenario changes, does not increase this amount.
scenarios.shortfall: This scenario falls {{amount}} below the cash reserved for your buffer, goals, and card commitments.
scenarios.projectionHelp: Estimate starting after {{date}}, after your buffer, reserved savings, card commitments, and planned contributions. The final month ends at the projection limit. Refresh the comparison when your plans or account data change.
scenarios.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}” and its saved assumptions? Your current plan and account data stay unchanged.
